verdict.rationale: Datalab's docs describe general document/image-to-markdown conversion (Marker, Surya, Chandra) but nowhere claim or demonstrate robustness on skewed pages, stamps, or low-quality/photographed scans specifically. The only community evidence found (HN comment on Chandra-OCR) criticizes a different limitation (lack of PDF-to-PDF round-tripping), not scan-quality accuracy, so it neither confirms nor disputes this specific axis. Missing for 10: any benchmark, docs section, or hands-on report addressing accuracy on skewed/rotated pages, stamped documents, or noisy photographed scans.
